resource_policy: fresh own-process CPU/RAM/filesystem observation; use available resources; no shared changes; no transient host PSI kill; only actual inputs/SOURCE/runtime/grant/results are immutable
failure_policy: STOP on own process failure, invalid input/source/profile/control/phase, nonfinite values, unpaired cost events or scientific mismatch; missing candidate cost remains null, no refit/imputation
trajectory_budget_formula: m * n_explore; m <=18 only after saved eligibility, exclude definitively ineligible q
compiled_axis_budget_formula: 2 * m * n_explore; <=36*n_explore; full wrapper for both axes, no reuse across different events
control_validation: For each newly acquired group sample0: independent particle-number oracle, low/high ancilla, relative scalar phase, Hadamard cos/sine, compiled full-vector <=1e-9; signed forced order0/2/4 remain controls outside cost sample. Register control/diagnostic compile entries separately; never hide them in cost-axis budget.
deduplication: existing six n8 groups are exploration only; preserve original seed SOURCE and old failures; no duplicate native groups
workers: independent system/formula/q/trajectory processes; cache immutable spectra/preparation per process and share cos/sine event sequence; set workers from fresh affinity/RAM and measured per-task footprint, no historical fixed cap
storage: private event replay and immutable source/input/profile/seed receipts; public lightweight metrics; QPY spooling only if needed. Fresh disk estimate must count 2*m*n wrappers before sealing.
acquisition_launcher: reuse corrected native kernels; new group/seed plan must be sealed in a separately authorized acquisition contract; this saved-only runner cannot sample/compile
